- “How do you want your refund?”

- “Refund to original payment method” / “Refund to card”
- “Store credit” / “Gift card”

- “Refund to original payment method” (or very similar wording)

- “Return options”

- “Drop off at location”
- “Drop off at carrier store”
- “Drop off at partner location”
